title: Jaya Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey
overview: Jayabharathi who was denied every simple joy in life while growing up just because she is a girl/woman is married to Rajesh, a male chauvinist, short-tempered and selfish person. On suffering domestic violence, she doesn't get any support. She then decides to fight back!

songs.title: Ingattu Nokkanda - Lofi Flip
songs.singers: Chris Wayne, Ankit Menon, Darshana Rajendran, Vinayak Sasikumar, SMXI
